thread.title: Apple event expected to show off new iPhones, Apple Watch: Live blog - MarketWatch

author: Jeremy C. Owens and Emily Bary
title: Apple event expected to show off new iPhones, Apple Watch: Live blog - MarketWatch
text:
Apple Inc. launched three new iPhones on Wednesday during the company’s biggest event of the year, as well as a new Apple Watch .
Apple introduced the iPhone XS Max, iPhone XS and iPhone XR models Wednesday during an event at the new Cupertino, Calif., headquarters of the world’s most valuable company. Apple AAPL, -1.24% said that the large-screen OLED model XS Max would start at $1,100, the upgraded version of the OLED iPhone X would again start at $1,000, and LCD-screen iPhone XR will start at $749.
See: Here’s how Apple’s stock performs around iPhone launch events
Some other Apple products also received attention Wednesday, including the Apple Watch . New watches feature edge-to-edge designs, meaning more usable screen space.
MarketWatch tech editor Jeremy C. Owens ( @jowens510 ) and reporter Emily Bary ( @emilybary ) live-blogged the announcements Wednesday. The recap is below.
